_doc: Datasheet-verified pinouts for the bare ICs on the test platform - the EXTERNAL
ground truth behind the datasheet-consistency rule. Each pin map here was extracted
INDEPENDENTLY from the cited manufacturer datasheet (not copied from board-model.py),
then confirmed to match the model. check-datasheets.py diffs every board model against
this file; a mismatch is an ALL-STOP (the datasheet contradicts the design).
Names follow the project's convention (so the diff is exact); each pin's FUNCTION was
verified against the datasheet, and 'notes' records any datasheet-literal name that
differs (e.g. MCP23017 pin 12 'SCK' = I2C SCL). To change an entry, re-verify against
the cited datasheet (doc + rev) and update 'verified'. Modules (ADS1115, DS3231, BMP180,
SSD1306, ...) are addressed/labelled parts, not pin-number-critical DIPs, and are not
covered here - their I2C addresses are tracked separately.

74HC595.notes: TI literals: Q0-Q7=QA-QH, Q7S=QH', DS=SER, SHCP=SRCLK, STCP=RCLK, MR=SRCLR (active-low), OE active-low

MCP4922.notes: datasheet pin12 = VSS (model labels AVSS); LDAC/SHDN active-low; pins 2,6,7 are NC

MCP42010.notes: CS/RS/SHDN active-low; pins 8-14 had a historical reverse-numbering bug - confirmed correct per DS11195C (8=PA0,9=PW0,10=PB0,11=RS,12=SHDN,13=SO,14=VDD)

MCP23017.notes: datasheet pin12 'SCK' = I2C SCL; pins 11,14 are NC on the I2C MCP23017 (CS/SO on the SPI MCP23S17); RESET active-low; INTB=19, INTA=20

HD44780.notes: datasheet RW = R/W; D0-D3 (pins 7-10) unused in 4-bit mode; A=LED+ (15), K=LED- (16)

_i2c_doc: Datasheet-verified I2C addressing for every addressable device. check-datasheets.py
computes each device's address from how the board model straps its address pins, then
checks it against the datasheet scheme below and the address declared in the component
value (e.g. 'MCP23017_0x20', 'ADS1115_0x48'). A disagreement is an ALL-STOP.
types: 'fixed' = no address pins; 'strap' = base + binary weights on named pins tied to
rails; 'strap_net' = one pin whose tied net selects the address; 'module' = strap is
internal to the breakout (not on the platform nets), address recorded for reference.

ADS1115.note: ADDR pin tie selects the address

DS3231.note: fixed in silicon, no address pins

BMP180.note: fixed, no address pins (0xEE write / 0xEF read)

AT24C32.note: base 0x50 + A2/A1/A0; ZS042 module ties all high -> 0x57

SSD1306.note: SA0 via D/C# pin: SA0=0 -> 0x3C, SA0=1 -> 0x3D; module fixes 0x3C
